description:
From [Tapas](https://www.mangaupdates.com/groups.html?id=4290065293):  

Kkotbun lives a miserable life as a slave in Joseon. As punishment for merely wanting an education, she is sent up a mountain to catch a rabbit in the dead of winter. When she comes across a ferocious tiger, she thinks she’s met her end, but to her surprise, she wakes up in a world filled with colorful magic. 

Renaming herself Rose, she’s now a potential pupil of the greatest light mage in the land. But with her affinity with dark magic, can she thrive rather than just survive in this new world?

**Original Webtoon:**
